Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

Choose an adjacent obstacle, grapple, or creature. Choose the intended result before rolling: reduce an obstacle’s remaining strength, reduce your Grappled rating, or push a creature. DA establishes any obstacle target. Grappled 3 leaves no Main Action to spend. On a Standard result, add 2 progress, grapple reduction, or squares of push.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Brawn
Target / range / shape
An adjacent obstacle, grapple, or creature
Duration
Instant
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Universal

Choose the intended result before rolling: reduce an obstacle’s remaining strength, reduce your Grappled rating, or push a creature. DA establishes any obstacle target. Grappled 3 leaves no Main Action to spend.

Weak
1 progress, grapple reduction, or square of push.
Standard
2 progress, grapple reduction, or squares of push.
Strong
3 progress, grapple reduction, or squares of push.

Stability: apply it only to the push option, not obstacle progress or Grappled reduction.
